title: Open restriction and open direct image commute
statement:
theorem nonempty_restrict_pushforward_open_iso
    {Y L : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ L) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (U : L.Opens) (P : U.toScheme.Modules) :
    Nonempty (restrict ((pushforward U.ι).obj P) j ≅
      (pushforward (j ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj (restrict P (j ∣_ U)))

source.place: Tags 008C (direct image on opens) and 0094 (module maps on ringed spaces)

proof.text: Set W=j inverse-image U and t=j restricted to U. The cartesian open square gives t image (W inverse-image T)=U inverse-image (j image T) for each open T of Y. Apply P.presheaf.mapIso to this equality for the component maps.

The square identity t followed by U inclusion=W inclusion followed by j gives equality of the scalar actions via appLE_comp_appLE and the inverse open-immersion structure-sheaf map. Presheaf.map_smul gives linearity. Presheaf functoriality and uniqueness of maps between opens give naturality. PresheafOfModules.isoMk and fullyFaithfulForget lift the component isomorphisms to sheaf modules. All opens, including empty ones, use the same calculation.
